proof_attempt_summary: Three D0 repair rounds and a maximality pass established a peer-reviewed supporting package: exact finite honest LP attainment, singular-channel Gaussian transfer, a uniform root-N value approximation rate, an arbitrary-tolerance certified algorithm, and a strict same-target projection gap. The full 15-dimensional execution produced only [0,19]; the sound narrowed public bracket 1.79 < Q(eta0) <= 11.14 does not meet the promised width-1/20 evaluated structural benchmark, and global coupling/drift/contact geometry remains open. D0.5 mathematical review passed with the citation verified, but the final contribution was graded incremental below the field floor; formalization was never entered.
tldr: Balanced complete randomization admits an exactly honest finite optimizer for the separately trimmed categorical causal contrast. On the maintained face-relative local/support class, its worst scaled expected length and the finite minimax value approach \(Q(\eta)=Q_G(\eta)\) with a computable uniform \(O(N^{-1/2})\) error, including singular supports with observed exact channels. The matching converse covers all labeled-record rules and transfers upward to every larger deterministic categorical class containing the maintained class, for the same target, connected randomized actions and exact-honesty requirement. Attainment remains a maintained-class conclusion. A terminating arbitrary-rational-tolerance algorithm supplies Gaussian upper rules and globally valid finite atomic lower certificates. At the dense public calibration, \(179/100<Q(\eta^0)\le557/50\), and the same-target projection gap exceeds \(19/20\). The sharp public value and binding coupling, drift and one-sided-contact geometry remain open.
gap: Rigdon--Hudgens, Li--Ding and Aronow--Chang--Lopatto establish exact binary mean-effect confidence intervals and increasingly fast inversion. They do not determine the categorical trimmed target or its globally certified all-procedure worst expected connected length. A weak count limit, a generic confidence game and a single covariance maximizer leave this object unresolved.
fill: The result evaluates \(Q(\eta)\), proves global coupling and drift contact certificates and their parameter transitions, preserves exact channels on singular supports, and transfers attaining rules and the all-procedure lower bound to the deterministic cohort. The public calibration supplies a certified same-target precision gain; marginal hypergeometric diagnostics make the observable cutoff consequences reviewable.
